title: Abbas qatl hogaye tanha hue hussain
body:
ABBAS QATL HOGAYE TANHA HUE HUSSAIN, THAME KAMAR KO ROTA HAI ZEHRA KA NOOR-E-AIN
SHAANE KATE HUE HAI TOH SAR HAI SHIGAFTA, BHAI KE ZAKHM DEKHTE HAIN ROOTE HAIN HUSSAIN
SHEH SE SAKINA KEHTI THI ABBAS HAIN KAHAN, KAISE TASALLI DEIN USSE AB SHAHE MASHRAQAIN
PAANI NA MANGONGI KABHI AMMU AB AA BHI JAO, KARTI THI BAS YE PYAASI SAKINA TADAP KE BAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
PARDE KA UNKE HAYE MOHAFIZ NAHI RAHA, MUSHKIL KUSHA KI BETIYAN KARTI HAIN SHOR-O-SHAIN
SUB KO DILASA DETI HAIN BINTE ALI MAGAR, KIS TARHA AYE ZAINAB-E-MUZTAR KE DIL KO CHAIN
BE DAST GHAZI GHODE SE KIS TARHA SE GIRA, MAIN LIKH RAHA HOON BINTE NABI KAR RAHI HAIN BAIN
UMMUL BANEEN KE LAAL PA ROTE HAIN HUM RASHEED, ZEHRA KE DIL KO MILTA HAI IN AANSUON SE CHAIN
